source_semantics.review: Individually review all nine complete files and eleven hunks of the internal M3-theme migration. CLI/PnP/e2e/Karma/Bazel defaults switch indigo-pink to azure-blue; e2e body adds mat-typography. E2E and universal styles replace their M2 theme recipe/compatibility switch with an experimental M3 define-theme (azure primary/blue tertiary), html-scoped component themes and global typography. These alter actual theme defaults, CSS scope and test environment. The drawer natural-width case explicitly sets width:auto because M3 has a fixed default width; all53 case identities remain and52 complete callbacks are unchanged. Do not copy that style override to hide a legacy/companion geometry failure or infer SSR/render/coexistence equivalence from this internal app change. The one original CLI style lacks a final newline; the complete-byte authenticator preserves that fact and proves the exact newline-producing hunk with eight negative controls, without repairing source bytes. The add-on keeps its finite Material16/M2 facade, public companion bridges and own RC/toolchain policy. Current exact private Node24/pnpm12/npm pins and independently wider published engine ranges remain unchanged; no upstream release/build/Karma defaults are inherited. Keep mixed M2/M3 coexistence as a real separate gate without forcing native M3 legacy theming or consumer HTML/CSS/SCSS migration. No product, consumer or golden edit and no runtime/Sass/SSR/floor pass is claimed.
